items.summary: IDC Frontier disclosed a ransomware attack that began October 7, forcing a shutdown of its IDCF Cloud East Japan Region 1 cluster and impacting 495 companies and local governments. The threat actor claims it encrypted 225 databases (3.6 PB) and 16,000 VM disks; customer management consoles remain disabled while the company verifies security.
items.title: Ransomware attack disrupts Japan's IDCF Cloud used by govt clients

items.summary: Atlassian released patches for CVE-2026-21589, a CVSS 9.3 unauthenticated arbitrary file access flaw affecting eight Data Center products (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, Crowd, Crucible, Fisheye). Exploitation attempts hit honeypots within two hours of technical details going public; Cloud customers are already patched.
items.title: Atlassian urges datacenter product users to patch critical file access vulnerability

items.summary: The DOJ and FBI announced court-authorized seizures of seven domains used to run 'Microscan' and 'FishHub,' intrusion tools used by China-linked Integrity Technology Group (Flax Typhoon) to scan and hack U.S. and foreign critical infrastructure. This is the second public disruption of Integrity Tech's infrastructure after the 2024 Flax Typhoon botnet takedown.
items.title: Justice Department and FBI seize vulnerability scanning and spear phishing tools operated by China-state sponsored hackers

items.summary: The GuidePoint Research and Intelligence Team recorded 2,760 ransomware victims in Q3 2026, a record quarter up 21% from Q2 and 75% year over year, across 112 active groups. Ransom payment rates fell by more than half year over year, but the average payment among those who paid rose 34%.
items.title: Record-high ransomware activity in Q3 2026: victims up 75% year over year

items.summary: CVE-2026-105845 is a critical SQL injection (CVSS 9.8) in Payload CMS 3.x through 3.87.x (SQLite/Postgres adapters) via unsanitized dynamic query filters, exploitable with no authentication in some configurations. Patches were released October 6 in 3.88.0 and 4.0.0-canary.27; users should restrict untrusted dynamic filters until patched.
items.title: Payload CMS SQL injection (CVE-2026-105845) rated critical, CVSS 9.8
